name: Kalecgos
summary: Kalecgos, often calling himself Kalec, is a young blue dragon serving as an investigator for the Spell-Weaver Malygos. Preferring the guise of a humble half-elf, he is unusually sympathetic toward mortal races and deeply invested in safeguarding Azeroth's arcane balance.

sections.title: A Dragon Among Mortals
sections.body: Unlike many of his kin in the blue dragonflight who look upon mortals with detached indifference or outright suspicion, Kalecgos chooses to walk among them as an equal. Adopting the appearance of a half-elf with striking blue-black hair, he favors approachable mortal guises so he can navigate Azeroth directly. His empathetic nature sets him apart from older, more aloof drakes, though he remains fiercely devoted to his flight's sacred duty of stewarding magic.

sections.title: The Quest for the Sunwell
sections.body: Following the devastation of the Third War, Kalecgos was dispatched by Malygos to Lordaeron and Quel'Thalas to trace the lingering remnants of the shattered Sunwell. His mission plunged him into conflict with dwarven dragon hunters, Scourge agents, and the elven traitor Dar'Khan Drathir. Alongside his intended, Tyrygosa, and the human paladin Jorad Mace, Kalec uncovered the truth behind the avatar Anveena Teague, protecting the font of power from falling into undead clutches.

faq.answer: Kalecgos is a young blue dragon who serves as an emissary and investigator for the blue dragonflight, sworn to safeguard arcane balance across Azeroth.

faq.q: Why does Kalecgos appear as a half-elf?
faq.answer: Kalecgos chose the guise of a half-human, half-elf so he could walk among mortal races as an approachable friend and equal, rather than assuming a grandiose or intimidating form.

faq.q: What brought Kalecgos to Lordaeron and Quel'Thalas?
faq.answer: Malygos tasked him with investigating residual magical energies left behind after the Scourge destroyed the High Elves' font of power, the Sunwell.

faq.q: What is his connection to Chronormu?
faq.answer: Kalecgos is a close friend of the bronze dragon Chronormu. Before Chromie chose her mortal gnome form, Kalec advised her on finding a visage that genuinely suited who she was.

angles.text: As a member of the blue dragonflight, Kalecgos is inherently tied to the arcane, making his insights into magical currents and ley energy deeply fascinating to practitioners of the Kirin Tor.
